(sum by (service_name) (increase(lmcache_mp_l2_prefetch_failure_chunks_total{service_name=~"$service_name"}[1m])) or (sum by (service_name) (increase(lmcache_mp_l2_prefetch_load_completed_chunks_total{service_name=~"$service_name"}[1m])) * 0)) / clamp_min((sum by (service_name) (increase(lmcache_mp_l2_prefetch_load_completed_chunks_total{service_name=~"$service_name"}[1m])) or (sum by (service_name) (increase(lmcache_mp_l2_prefetch_failure_chunks_total{service_name=~"$service_name"}[1m])) * 0)) + (sum by (service_name) (increase(lmcache_mp_l2_prefetch_failure_chunks_total{service_name=~"$service_name"}[1m])) or (sum by (service_name) (increase(lmcache_mp_l2_prefetch_load_completed_chunks_total{service_name=~"$service_name"}[1m])) * 0)), 1e-9)
